qa_pairs.question: What kind of information is presented in the section following the displayed image in the Metrix portal?
qa_pairs.answer: The section following the displayed image in the Metrix portal shows information related to the scheduler.

qa_pairs.question: How can an Alliance user display information about their CPU account within the Metrix portal?
qa_pairs.answer: To display information about your CPU account in the Metrix portal, you need to click on your account number.
